scenes.heading: Building a repeatable client onboarding process

sents.d: Building a repeatable client onboarding process
A structured onboarding process sets the tone for the whole relationship.

A social media management onboarding process typically includes gathering brand assets and guidelines, getting access to relevant accounts, understanding the client's goals and target audience, and agreeing on a content approval process before any posts go live.

Requesting admin access to accounts (rather than being handed login credentials informally) through proper platform business tools protects both the client's account security and your own liability if something goes wrong.

Setting expectations about typical timelines — when the client will see the first content calendar, when results reporting begins — during onboarding prevents anxious check-ins in the first few weeks.

take: Onboard with assets, access and an approval process.
